items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I used to walk out in front of 2040 Seventh Avenue and I'd see Louis Armstrong and Cab Calloway... all coming to New York to play the Apollo Theatre... and you just never knew who you'd see next. It was a thrill each time.

ctx.x: So a lot of bands came through...

A lot of bands came through Detroit and played the Fox Theater. You see, again I said, shows were factors. Shows were the principal items and the musicians...Of course, they would begin that transition period of...from shows to just having...they'd have like a vaudeville--five acts--and maybe the principal act would be the band. Duke and Lucky Millinder and Cab Calloway and, of course, Count Basie hadn't left Kansas City then. He didn't leave Kansas City until...
